## Goal

State the problem, success criteria, and non-goals.

## Change

Summarize the files and behavior changed.

## Verification

List every exact final-candidate command and its exact pass, fail, or blocked result.

List the final CI workflow/check names, run links or IDs, conclusion, and head SHA.

## Hosted GitHub controls

Record each applicable hosted control, inspection method/date/result, and any explicit `UNVERIFIED`, `DISABLED`, `PLAN_LIMITED`, or unsupported state. Repository files are not proof of hosted settings.

## Files and authority

List every changed file with its purpose. Identify the canonical current-state path and any authority/protocol/source map affected.

## Recovery

Explain how to detect and reverse an incorrect change.

## Documentation

List updated plans, state, or lesson files.

## Lesson closeout

Disposition substantive findings as project-specific, promoted, provisional, superseded, or no-new-lesson. Link any universal lesson commit or PR.

## Merge and residual risk

State the final commit SHA, remaining owner decisions/residual risk, and merge result or exact ready-to-merge blocker. End the final report with exactly one approved compliance terminal label.

- [ ] Final diff reviewed
- [ ] Final-head checks pass
- [ ] Remaining limitations recorded
